_comment: Show image files a person checked by eye and rejected, keyed by md5 of the file bytes. scripts/check-image-aspect.js refuses any staged image with one of these hashes (and removes it in --staged --quarantine mode, which runs before the auto-fetch commit), so a re-fetch cannot bring the bytes back. tests/unit/show-hero-integrity.test.mjs fails if one is committed anyway.
